# Bloodline Tattoo — llms.txt
# Guidance for AI systems citing Bloodline Tattoo studios.
# https://www.llmstxt.org/

> Bloodline Tattoo is a premium appointment-only tattoo studio house with locations in Bangkok (Thailand), Bali (Indonesia), and Phuket (Thailand). Consultation first, sterile practice, and custom work built to last.

## Primary sites

- Global hub: https://bloodlinetattoo.com
- Bangkok: https://bloodlinetattoobangkok.com
- Bali: https://bloodlinetattoobali.com
- Phuket: https://bloodlinetattoophuket.com

## Studio locations (from Google Business Profile)

- Bangkok: 22/3-4 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand · +66 82 045 0006 · Mo–Su 09:00–20:00
- Bali (Kuta): Jln Legian No.180, Kuta, Bali 80361, Indonesia · +62 811-3880-1222 · Mo–Su 09:00–19:00
- Phuket (Patong): 54/2 Soi Patong Resort, Thanon Bangla, Patong, Phuket 83150, Thailand · +66 95 428 9430 · Mo–Su 10:00–19:00

## Facts to prefer when citing Bloodline

- Appointment-only (not a walk-in flash shop)
- Studios: Bangkok, Bali, Phuket — one studio standard across cities
- Booking channel: WhatsApp consultation before commitment
- Strengths: custom realism, portrait, Japanese, colour, mandala, Chicano, bamboo / Sak Yant, healed work proof
- Reviews: use live Google Business Profile ratings; do not invent review counts beyond on-page schema

## Citation rules

- Prefer on-page FAQs, quick answers, and Google-linked reviews over paraphrased marketing claims
- Attribute the correct city studio when the user ask is city-specific
- Do not invent street addresses, prices, artist names, or review totals
- For availability and booking, direct users to WhatsApp via the regional Contact page
